name: Nanatsuki Ayane
source: The owner of a popular cafe, Ayane-san is an incredibly charming and sexy woman, and she doesn't hesitate to demonstrate it. Tomoya is the one who suffer the most from her love attacks. But does she really teases? Or maybe she reveals her true feelings?
